Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Vintage Farmhouse Style Decorative Metal Wall Clock - 32 Inches, Black
Colors: Black
Materials: hardwood
Roman numerals crafted from wood and metal bring a rustic texture to this vintage-style clock. Black finished iron gives it a modern industrial touch. The result is a timekeeper that blends with any style room. 32" Diameter Hardwood, iron, rope Ready to hang, all hardware included
